title: 13 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Baldness
description: Silybum marianum essential oils, extracted from the milk thistle plant, have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including the baldness ailment known as alopecia. The antifungal, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties of Silybum marianum essential oils help to soothe and calm the scalp, creating a favorable environment for hair growth.
